theme: term structure of volatility as a directional/timing signal for equity
lag_semantics: lag0 = 15:55 read of the vol indices, MOC fill, earns t->t+1

bootstrap_null.statistic: max over all tested formulas of as-written net Sharpe

results.name: H21_A4_INVERT_HOLD
results.why: A4's inversion depth held 21 days. PANIC IMPULSE: forced hedgers buy near-dated vol on a risk-limit trigger, flattening or inverting the front of the curve; that demand is non-informational and unwinds, so equity is cheap while they pay up.
results.a_priori_sign: long equity

results.a_priori_sign: long equity for 21 days after a fresh inversion

results.name: G4_UNINVERSION_10D
